jobs.title: Program Manager Business Applications (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
## Position Overview

dormakaba Global IT is seeking a Program Manager SAP & Business Applications to lead the execution of critical enterprise transformation initiatives. This role is central to delivering large-scale SAP programs that underpin dormakaba’s core business processes across finance, supply chain and operations.
 You will join a global IT organization focused on translating innovation into scalable, business-relevant solutions. With SAP as a strategic platform, dormakaba continues to evolve its systems and processes to support a more connected, efficient and digital enterprise.

## What you will do

- Taking full ownership of strategic programs from initiation through to successful delivery and value realization. This includes managing scope, timelines, budget, risks and dependencies across multiple workstreams and partners.
- Establishing and leading governance structures with senior business and IT stakeholders, ensuring transparency, alignment and effective decision-making.
- Steering execution on a day-to-day basis, proactively resolving issues and bringing clarity to complex and fast-moving environments.
- Leading cross-functional, multi-vendor teams across regions, fostering collaboration and a strong sense of shared accountability.
- Actively building alignment across stakeholders and ensuring that delivered solutions are anchored sustainably within the organization.
- Promoting a structured and transparent approach to risk, quality and change management, ensuring stability and long-term value creation.

The SAP Focus

SAP transformations are at the core of this role. You bring strong experience in managing complex SAP landscapes and understand the critical success factors of large-scale implementations.
 While you are not expected to configure SAP systems yourself, you have the expertise to challenge delivery approaches, assess integration risks, and ensure alignment between functional, technical and business perspectives. You confidently engage with business leaders, SAP functional experts, and implementation partners to keep programs on track and outcome-focused.

## What we require

You Bring

- A proven track record of leading complex enterprise programs end-to-end, with at least 7 years in program or project management.
- Hands-on experience delivering SAP implementations or transformations across the full lifecycle, including planning, go-live and hypercare.
- Strong experience managing multi-vendor, cross-functional teams across international environments.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior executives.
- Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe; SAP or ITIL certifications are an advantage.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences.
- Working proficienct in both English and German.
 You Are

-
• Outcome-driven and take ownership beyond status reporting.
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and translating complexity into clear plans and decisions.
- A strong communicator who builds trust and alignment across diverse stakeholders.
- Resilient and composed, able to perform effectively in demanding and dynamic environments.
- Value-oriented, focusing on sustainable business impact rather than pure delivery metrics.
- Collaborative and proactive, with a mindset that drives continuous improvement and shared success.

## What we offer

- Best opportunities in a globally operating company with a family business culture
- Attractive salary package
- Development opportunities
- Employee support program
- Monetary benefits (online discount system for shopping, travel, insurance etc.)
- Additional benefits such as free parking and an on-site restaurant
- Flexibility through a hybrid working model

## Who we are
 We are at the heart of every place that matters. From automatic doors to cloud-based access management – as a leading global provider in the access solutions market for schools, banks, airports, hospitals, hotels, and many more, we enable seamless movement within secure, safe, and sustainable places. With over 160 years of experience and a focus on excellence and innovation, we offer exciting opportunities to grow in an environment where you can make a real impact. At dormakaba, you are encouraged to take initiative, develop your skills, and build your career alongside 16,000 experts worldwide who are setting industry standards every day.
 Work in a place where you matter – apply now!

dormakaba Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We take action to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Servicetechniker/-in (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Bei dormakaba gilt nicht nur «for every place that matters” sondern auch “a place where you matter”. Dieses Motto gilt für alle unsere Mitarbeiter, aber ganz besonders für unsere Montage- und Servicetechniker. Montage- und Servicetechniker stellen die Basis unserer Serviceorganisation dar, denn jedes Produkt ist am Ende nur so gut wie die Person, die es bei unseren Kunden installiert hat. Dementsprechend hoch ist auch die Wertschätzung unserer Kunden gegenüber unserem Montage- und Service Personal. Egal ob es um die Installation, Wartung oder Fehlerbehebung geht, unsere Spezialisten sind stets gerne gesehen.

Ein Job, der zählt: Deine Aufgaben

- Du montierst und verdrahtest Antriebskomponenten und Sensorik
- Du konfigurierst und nimmst automatischen Türen und Vereinzelungsanlagen in Betrieb
- Du kümmerst dich um die Störungsbehebung an automatischen Türen und Vereinzelungsanlagen
- Du reparierst und setzt automatischen Türen instand
- Du modernisierst bestehenden Türanlagen
- Mit deinen Kollegen übernimmst du im Turnus den natürlich bezahlten 24 Stunden Pikettdienst
- Du unterstützt bei Montagen
- Du dokumentierst die erbrachte Leistung (Abnahme und Prüfzeugnisse)
- Du übergibst die Anlagen an die Kunden

Erfahrung, die zählt: Deine Fähigkeiten

- Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z.B. als Automatiker, Elektroinstallateur, Anlagen- und Apparatebauer oder Aus-/Weiterbildungen im Bereich Mechatroniker
- Gute Informatikkenntnisse (MS Office; Umgang mit Parametriersoftware)
- Handwerkliches Geschick und selbständiges, zuverlässiges Arbeiten
- Problemlösungs- und dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit
- Fahrausweis Kat. B
- Sicheres und gepflegtes Auftreten, Erfahrung im Service

Ein Arbeitsplatz, der zählt: Unser Angebot

- Beste Chancen in einem global agierenden Konzern mit der Kultur eines Familienunternehmens
- Attraktives Gehaltspaket
- Transparente und klar definierte Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- Unterstützung von Milizarbeit /Gemeinnützigen Projekten und auch während der Arbeitszeit

dormakaba ist ein Arbeitgeber, welcher sich für Chancengleichheit, Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzt. Wir ergreifen Massnahmen, um für alle Bewerbungen, ohne Rücksicht auf Ethnie, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale, Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten.

FÜR DIESE STELLE AKZEPTIEREN WIR KEINE DOSSIERS VON PERSONALVERMITTLUNGEN

jobs.description:
Lead a cross‑functional team delivering innovative, integrated processes and solutions across Data, Analytics and HR -enhancing efficiency, effectiveness and value while reducing complexity enterprise‑wide; drive process integration, process intelligence and automation as shared services for all Business Applications, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, regional scalability, agile continuous improvement, and user‑centric outcomes that keep dormakaba competitive, data‑driven, and future‑ready.
 In addition, the role ensures enterprise‑level data quality & governance, architecture alignment and cost‑efficient designs, and safe, predictable releases across applications and platforms.
 The Lead Cross‑Enterprise Solutions & Integration owns and orchestrates enterprise services across:

- Data Architecture & Governance / MDM including enterprise standards, lifecycle rules, quality, migration.
- Analytics & BI including global reporting architecture, consistency, enablement, and lifecycle delivery.
- HR Solutions including design, build and run of HR landscape with compliant enhancements and rollouts.
- Solution Architecture (Business Applications) including full lifecycle - from early assessment and conceptual architecture to governance, compliance, and implementation guidance - across all relevant business applications.
- Process Integration & Design and Automation.
- Release & Change Management: synchronized enterprise release planning/execution, CAB governance, readiness, and post‑release validation. The IT Release Manager collaborates with application owners, development teams, infrastructure teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to manage the full release lifecycle—from release planning and dependency mapping to deployment, communication, readiness checks, and post‑release validation. This position plays a central role in ensuring cross‑application alignment, improving release stability, and strengthening governance across the enterprise.

A job that matters: your tasks

- Strategy & Leadership
• Set the vision, roadmap and operating model for cross‑enterprise services covering Data, Analytics, HR solutions, Integration, Process Intelligence & Automation.
- Establish shared service capabilities and agile, product‑oriented delivery across regions and business units.
- Build and develop a high‑performing, customer‑centric team (internal & partners).

- Analytics & Reporting
• Own the global reporting architecture to minimize systems and maximize efficiency; ensure consistent, benchmarkable figures; enable adoption of global reporting standards.
- Leverage strong SAP BI expertise to drive the development and optimization of global reporting solutions

- Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
• Facilitate workshops, communicate decisions and trade‑offs, and ensure clarity for business, IT, and security stakeholders globally.

- Data Governance & Quality
• Define and maintain enterprise data standards, ownership, hierarchies and lifecycle rules (phase‑in/change/phase‑out).
- Implement data quality rules/KPIs, monitoring and remediation with Business Owners and data stewards; lead harmonization and migration for programs.

- AI
• Facilitate the definition of AI Use Cases to gain efficiencies in Business and IT

- Enterprise Architecture & Roadmaps
• Drive option analyses, fit‑gap, and TCO‑based evaluations; define NFRs and target/transition architectures; maintain Architecture Decision Records; prepare ARB submissions.
- Align application, integration, data, cloud, security, and infrastructure views; capture assumptions and risks.

- Process Integration & Interoperability
• Standardize integration patterns (APIs, ESB/middleware, BTP/CPI), secure data flows, and ownership models; ensure E2E consistency with process and data architectures.

- Release & Change Management
• Manage an enterprise release calendar; align dependencies; run go/no‑go, readiness, rollback planning; ensure ITIL/CAB adherence and high‑quality documentation.

- HR Solutions (SuccessFactors)
• Govern HR solution evolution and global rollouts within the template; ensure compliance and alignment with People & Culture strategy.

An experience that matters: your skills

- 10+ years overall in enterprise IT with 5+ years leading two or more domains among Solution/Enterprise Architecture, Data/MDM, BI/Analytics, HR (SuccessFactors), Integration, Release/Change in complex, multi‑application environments.
- Strong experience with SAP BI is mandatory, ideally including first experiences with SAP BDC
- Proven delivery across global programs and distributed teams.
- Ability to coach and lead cross‑functional teams through influence and structured processes.
- Strong communication and facilitation ability.
- Experience coordinating external partners and vendors.
- Experience running planning workshops and review meetings.
- Skilled in conflict management and problem resolution.
- Team oriented, structured, reliable, strong communication skills, service minded, capable of working under pressure, solution oriented, proactive, independent working style, strong ownership, open‑minded, flexible, culturally aware and strategic/innovative thinker.
- English - Business fluency.
 Additional skills non-mandatory, but valuable for the position:

• SAP (S/4HANA/MDG/SF, Salesforce, ESB/API management, BTP/CPI; Azure data services/warehousing; test automation.
- German - Colloquial knowledge.

jobs.description:
En tant que Responsable régional des ventes, vous êtes en charge du développement commercial en Suisse romande pour les solutions de contrôle d’accès et la technique de porte. Vous pilotez la performance commerciale de votre région avec votre équipe, en suivant la stratégie commerciale définie par le siège, et en mettant en œuvre une approche structurée, proactive et orientée résultats.

Vous assurez également des synergies et du cross-selling avec le département de vente des portes automatiques, et développez les relations B2B, B2C et avec les partenaires.

- Atteindre les objectifs de vente définis (budget et KPI) dans votre région
- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une planification commerciale structurée
- Encadrer et développer l’équipe de conseillers de vente
- Accompagner les équipes dans la présentation et le conseil de solutions auprès de clients finaux, maîtres d’ouvrage, entreprises générales, architectes, planificateurs et bureaux d’ingénieurs
- Développer et acquérir de nouveaux clients et projets
- Assurer le suivi et la fidélisation des clients existants
- Participer activement aux actions de promotion et événements commerciaux
- Soutenir l’élaboration de concepts de sécurité et d’offres à forte valeur ajoutée
- Garantir la bonne conclusion des ventes (technique, commerciale et administrative)
- Effectuer des visites régulières clients et partenaires
- Assurer un reporting mensuel (résultats, activités, marché, concurrence)
- Documenter et suivre les activités commerciales dans le CRM (Salesforce)

C’EST POURQUOI NOUS VOUS FAISONS CONFIANCE: VOS COMPÉTENCES

- Formation dans le domaine de la vente requise, une formation technique complémentaire étant considérée comme un atout
- Expérience confirmée dans la vente B2B et B2C, idéalement complétée par une expérience dans la collaboration avec des architectes, entreprises générales (EG), maîtres d’ouvrage et bureaux d’ingénieurs
- Expérience confirmée en management d’équipe commerciale
- Excellentes compétences en négociation, avec une forte orientation résultats
- Méthode de travail structurée, autonome et orientée client
- Excellentes capacités relationnelles avec des interlocuteurs techniques et décisionnels
- Capacité à anticiper et à exploiter les compétences du futur dormakaba, incluant : compétences digitales, résolution de problèmes, transmission du savoir-faire, capacité d’adaptation, design thinking et gestion agile du changement
- Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais et/ou de l’allemand, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
- Permis de conduire valide

VOUS POUVEZ COMPTER SUR NOUS: UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL MOTIVANT

- Nous offrons des conditions d’emploi attrayantes avec des avantages divers
- Des possibilités de télétravail partiel
- Nous agissons dans un environnement technologique passionnant
- Nous sommes un groupe international avec une atmosphère familiale
- Nous accordons une grande importance à la promotion du développement personnel et professionnel

jobs.description:
Als Werkscontroller ( Finance Business Partner) – verantwortest du die finanzielle Steuerung, Planung und Analyse des Produktionswerks in der Schweiz. Du stellst die Genauigkeit und Transparenz der Finanzdaten sicher, unterstützt strategische Entscheidungen des Managements und treibst aktiv Prozessoptimierungen sowie die Weiterentwicklung des Werks voran. In dieser Schlüsselrolle agierst du als Sparringspartner für interne Stakeholder auf lokaler, regionaler und globaler Ebene.

## DAS ÖFFNET DIE TÜR ZU DEINER ZUKUNFT: DEINE AUFGABEN

- Verantwortung für monatliche, quartalsweise und jährliche Abschlussprozesse inklusive Sicherstellung korrekter, vollständiger und fristgerechter Finanzberichte
- Leitung des Mid-Term-Planungsprozesses, der jährlichen Budgetzyklen sowie der rollierenden Forecasts
- Durchführung, Pflege und Aktualisierung der Standardkosten im Einklang mit operativen Zielsetzungen
- Analyse von GuV- und Bilanzabweichungen, Identifikation von Trends sowie Ableitung von Massnahmen zur Performance-Steigerung
- Überwachung relevanter KPIs und aktive Unterstützung von Produktivitäts- und Effizienzinitiativen
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Einkauf, Supply Chain und Operations
- Umsetzung und Überwachung von Corporate-Governance-Vorgaben sowie Identifikation und Reduzierung finanzieller und operativer Risiken
- Strategische Business-Partner-Rolle für Plant Management, regionale Führungskräfte und globale Finance-Teams
- Förderung eines einheitlichen Finanzverständnisses und Stärkung der finanziellen Transparenz im gesamten Unternehmen

## DESHALB VERTRAUEN WIR DIR: DEINE FÄHIGKEITEN

- 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Finance/Controlling, idealerweise im industriellen oder produktionsnahen Umfeld
- Bachelor-Abschluss in Rechnungswesen, Finanzen oder Wirtschaft
- MBA, CPA oder vergleichbare Zusatzqualifikationen von Vorteil
- Sehr gutes Verständnis von Produktions- und Kostenstrukturen
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie hohe Business-Orientierung
- Sicheres Auftreten als Sparringspartner auf Management-Ebene
- Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch

## DARAUF KANNST DU DICH VERLASSEN: EIN MOTIVIERENDES ARBEITSUMFELD

- Einblicke in die Finanzwelt eines global agierenden Konzerns mit familiärer Unternehmenskultur
- Mitarbeit an spannenden Finanzprojekten und internationalem Austausch
- Ein Team, das dich unterstützt und gemeinsam mit dir wachsen möchte
- Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
- Attraktives Gehaltspaket, Home-Office-Möglichkeit, gute ÖV-Anbindung und ein erstklassiges Personalrestaurant

jobs.description:
## What you will do

- Responsible for leading and delivering high-quality, innovative, and market intelligence–driven category management within the Castings & Forgings spend area, ensuring the availability of goods and services
- Regional- category target driver, achiever and communicate targets within the regional community in alignment with global category targets. Distributes global and / or regional target to local category teams in alignment with GCM. Implementation and drive of the regional target / KPIs with support of the GCM and LCM. Supports the plants, LAC’s and markets to achieve their targets.
- Developing and executing professional regional sourcing strategies for the assigned spend categories in region EURAF, regional (EURAF operations and markets) as well as execute constant market observation on price-, supplier-, market- product development and innovation. Align strategy with global category manager for global spend categories.
- Execution of regional Contract- and Supplier relationship management including supplier development and innovation. Ensures that local requirements are covered in contract annexes.
- Consolidates requirements and demands in category management from across EURAF as input for global category strategies. Ensures top-down and bottom-up alignment
- Build working relationships with key stakeholders, other category teams, regional suppliers and external partners
- Lead regional strategic sourcing projects, which secure the goods, works and services that most appropriately identify the addressed needs of the customers and users whilst ensuring value for money, compliance with relevant policy and procurement legislation and generating cashable and non-cashable efficiencies throughout the life of contracts
- Executing professional regional tenders (RFx) including establishing and negotiating contracts according to the defined sourcing strategy for a specific spend category
- Supporting the Global CM in providing regional market analysis, trends, foresight & warnings, supplier- and market data
- Ensuring that global standards, processes and templates are use in the region as well as harmonization and transparency on parts and tooling
- Major tasks are according to role profiles "Global Category Manager and Regional Category Manger’’ roles and responsibility (annex)

##

## What we require

- Completed degree in a business or technical field (e.g. Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, etc.) or a comparable qualification
- At least 3 years of experience in a similar position in strategic procurement, with a focus on castings & forgings
- Proven track record in conducting global tenders and negotiations in an international environment
- Experience in stakeholder management as well as working with international teams
- Strong communicator with excellent networking skills
- Very good German and English skills , both written and spoken
- Strong negotiation skills and analytical thinking, Problem solving capability

## What we offer

- Best opportunities in a globally operating company with a family business culture
- Attractive salary package
- Development opportunities
- Employee support program
- Monetary benefits (online discount system for shopping, travel, insurance etc.)

This position can also be filled at other dormakaba locations.

Distribuisce obiettivo globale e / o regionale per le squadre di categoria locali in allineamento con GCM. Attuazione e azionamento del target regionale / KPI con supporto del GCM e del LCM. Supporta le piante, LAC e i mercati per raggiungere i loro obiettivi. - Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di approvvigionamento regionale professionale per le categorie di spesa assegnate nella regione EURAF, regionale (operazioni e mercati EURAF) nonché eseguire un'osservazione costante del mercato sui prezzi, sui fornitori, sullo sviluppo e sull'innovazione dei prodotti di mercato. Allineare la strategia con il manager di categoria globale per le categorie di spesa globali. - Esecuzione della gestione regionale dei rapporti contrattuali e dei fornitori, tra cui sviluppo dei fornitori e innovazione.
